title: Netflix’s ‘Big Mistakes’ Took Dany Levy Out of His Comfort Zone. He Wants Hollywood to Know Why That’s OK
summary: The co-creator and star of the new crime comedy is managing expectations after his 'Schitt’s Creek’ success. He talks to The Hollywood Reporter about venturing into a new genre with his return to TV, collaborating with the likes of co-creator Rachel Sennott and losing his onscreen mom, Catherine O'Hara.
